row.question: What can this champion do?

citations.quote: Dealing two instances of ability damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants 1 / 2 / 3 (based on level) Splinters.
Ranking up an ability with any skill points beyond level 1 grants 5 Splinters, up to 85.
Killing a large minion grants 1 Splinter.
Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance her abilities based on the number of them collected

claims.claim: Transcendent collects Splinters of Wrath through repeated ability damage to champions, ability rank-ups and large-minion kills, progressively upgrading Syndra's abilities.

citations.quote: Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores mana for Syndra. At the maximum amount of Splinters, her ability power is increased.

claims.claim: Splinters collected from enemies restore mana, and reaching maximum stacks increases her ability power.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Explains her progression and why repeated trades can fuel her growth and mana.

row.answer: Transcendent collects Splinters of Wrath through repeated ability damage to champions, ability rank-ups and large-minion kills, progressively upgrading Syndra's abilities. Splinters collected from enemies restore mana, and reaching maximum stacks increases her ability power.
row.counterplay: Limit repeated ability hits during trades and respect her upgraded abilities as she progresses.
row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: After a brief delay, Syndra conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location that deals magic damage to nearby enemies. The Dark Sphere then remains on the ground for a few seconds.
The sphere remains and can be manipulated by her other powers.

claims.claim: Dark Sphere appears at a chosen location after a brief delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and remaining on the ground for her other abilities to use.

citations.quote: Dark Sphere: Syndra can hold an additional charge

claims.claim: Its Transcendent upgrade lets Syndra store an additional charge.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Her main sphere setup enables damage and subsequent stun threats.

row.answer: Dark Sphere appears at a chosen location after a brief delay, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies and remaining on the ground for her other abilities to use. Its Transcendent upgrade lets Syndra store an additional charge.
row.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area and avoid lining up behind lingering spheres.

citations.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Force of Will deals bonus true damage.

claims.claim: Its Transcendent upgrade adds bonus true damage.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

row.answer: Force of Will grabs a Dark Sphere, enemy minion or non-epic monster, then can throw it at a chosen location to deal magic damage and slow enemies in the landing area. Its Transcendent upgrade adds bonus true damage.
row.counterplay: Keep moving while she holds an object and avoid its landing area.
row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: Syndra propels a wave of force in a cone in the target direction that deals magic damage and knocks back enemies hit based on proximity.

claims.claim: Scatter the Weak sends a cone of force that deals magic damage and knocks enemies back.

citations.quote: A Dark Sphere can be knocked back further, which knocks back enemies hit and briefly stuns and reveals them

claims.claim: It also pushes Dark Spheres farther, stunning and revealing enemies they hit

citations.quote: Collecting 80 Splinters of Wrath enhances Scatter the Weak to have an increased scatter angle and slow enemies hit by 70% for 1.25 seconds starting after the knock back ends or if the target was hit by a pushed Dark Sphere, after the stun has ended.

claims.claim: its Transcendent upgrade widens the cone and adds a slow after the knockback or sphere stun ends.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Her knockback and sphere stun are major threats and a key defensive tool.

row.answer: Scatter the Weak sends a cone of force that deals magic damage and knocks enemies back. It also pushes Dark Spheres farther, stunning and revealing enemies they hit; its Transcendent upgrade widens the cone and adds a slow after the knockback or sphere stun ends.
row.counterplay: Avoid standing in a line from Syndra through a sphere, and look for an approach after she uses the knockback.
row.question: What does this ability do?

citations.quote: Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.

claims.claim: Unleashed Power barrages a target enemy champion with newly created spheres and nearby existing spheres, each dealing magic damage.

citations.quote: The Dark Spheres will then remain on the ground next to the target's current location for 6 seconds.
Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste.

claims.claim: The spheres remain on the ground afterward, and its passive reduces Dark Sphere's cooldown.

citations.quote: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.

claims.claim: Its Transcendent upgrade executes the target if its damage would leave them below a low-health threshold.

evidence.verification_scope: Exact citations/structural checks; no new AI verifier or editorial approval

importance.reason: Targeted burst and the upgraded execute make low-health engagements dangerous.

row.answer: Unleashed Power barrages a target enemy champion with newly created spheres and nearby existing spheres, each dealing magic damage. The spheres remain on the ground afterward, and its passive reduces Dark Sphere's cooldown. Its Transcendent upgrade executes the target if its damage would leave them below a low-health threshold.
row.counterplay: Keep your health up before approaching and respect nearby spheres during and after her barrage.
